ValidationRule.description: VR-QLI-03: Blocks QLI create/edit after Quote moves from Draft. Reserved__c (inventory assignment) always allowed. Billing_Mode__c and Target_BAN__c allowed through Presented, locked at Accepted.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Quote.Status, 'Draft')), NOT(ISCHANGED(Reserved__c)), NOT(ISCHANGED(Billing_Mode__c)), NOT(ISCHANGED(Target_BAN__c)) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Quote.Status, 'Accepted'), OR( ISCHANGED(Billing_Mode__c), ISCHANGED(Target_BAN__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This quote is no longer in Draft status. Line items can only be edited in Draft. Use Revise Quote to create a new version. Inventory assignment (Reserved), Billing Mode, and Target BAN changes are allowed through Presented status.
